text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected for service=redwood-inference-gateway cluster=us-west-2. 5xx spike > 8% over baseline for the last 3m. Paging oncall.

maria (SRE): acked. paging alex oncall. any idea if recent deploy or LB change?

alex (oncall): I'm on it. pulling metrics now. p95 latency up from 120ms -> 420ms, error rate 8.7% over last 5m. Most 502/504 and some 500. Route: /v1/generate -> inference-gateway -> model-pool.

jonathan (platform): I pushed a loadbalancer route tweak an hour ago to adjust weights for canary. It touched the gateway route config (route table 3). rolling back if that looks likely.

sasha (eng): checking envoy stats on the gateway. hitting admin endpoint with:

```
curl -s "http://127.0.0.1:9901/stats?filter=cluster\.model-pool|listener_0" | egrep "upstream_rq_{5xx|total}|cx_overflow|rq_timeout"
```

sasha (eng): stats show `cluster.model-pool.upstream_rq_5xx: 1240` and `cluster.model-pool.rq_timeout: 312` last 5m. also `cx_overflow` spikes on a subset of endpoints.

maria (SRE): sounds like route weight change pushed traffic to smaller shard and overloaded it leading to timeouts and 502 from backend. could be retry amplification too. we should disable retries at the gateway temporarily.

alex (oncall): rolling an emergency patch: set retry policy to none on the gateway route to stop amplification. applying a patch to envoy route config now. will also set circuit breaker max_connections lower to shed load gracefully. patch command:

```
# kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  envoy.yaml: |
    route_config:
      virtual_hosts:
      - name: inference
        routes:
        - match: { prefix: "/v1/" }
          retry_policy: { retry_on: "", num_retries: 0 }
          cluster: model-pool
```

jonathan (platform): also revert the weight change for canary -> set original weights back. doing `lb update --route inference --weights 80,20` -> to previous 95,5.

nora (support): FYI support: we are seeing multiple customer errors reported — 4 paid customers and a handful of internal smoke tests failing. Error messages are `502 Bad Gateway` and `504 Gateway Timeout`. timestamps: last 10m. impact: user API calls failing intermittently. ticket tally: 7 active.

alex (oncall): patch applied. disabling retries; reverting weight. monitoring.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Started rollout of config-change/6487654321 on gateway-us-west-2 (canary 0%).

sasha (eng): after disabling retries, still seeing some timeouts but 5xx rate dropped to ~3.2% in next 2m. some backend pods showing heavy CPU. running `kubectl top pods -n inference | grep model-pool` shows 2 pods at 95% CPU.

maria (SRE): scale model-pool horizontally by +3 replicas to absorb backlog. patches to HPA applied.

alex (oncall): scaling done. also temporarily increase `outlier_detection` interval to reduce eject flapping.

jonathan (platform): I'm reverting the canary change fully and will pin routing to balanced distribution while we stabilize. also plan to lower connection draining timeout so unhealthy backends don't keep connections open.

nora (support): informing the customers in the affected tickets: "We're aware of increased 5xx errors for inference and teams are actively mitigating. Expect intermittent errors to continue for ~15-30 minutes while we stabilize. We'll update in this thread." asked for any customer-visible ETA.

maria (SRE): estimated ETA ~20m to full recovery after scaling and retry policy change. will keep monitoring. root cause hypothesis: LB route weight change -> traffic concentrated -> backend overload -> retries amplified 5xx cascade -> circuit breaker reactions.

alex (oncall): metrics now: error rate 1.1% and p95 latency 180ms. rolling window for 5m now below our paging threshold. continuing to watch for 15m to confirm.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Alert recovered: 5xx rate returned below threshold for cluster=us-west-2. Incident remains open for postmortem until RCA done.

sasha (eng): saving relevant envoy config diff for postmortem. snippet of problematic config that caused retry amplification:

```
routes:
  - match: { prefix: "/v1/" }
    route: { cluster: model-pool }
    retry_policy: { retry_on: "5xx,connect,gateways", num_retries: 2 }
    per_filter_config:
      envoy.filters.http.router:
        disable_collision_drain: false
```

maria (SRE): action items:
- revert LB weight (done)
- disable retry policy during overload (done)
- scale model-pool (done)
- run postmortem to add safer rollout guard (circuit limits & canary ramp checks)
- notify customers (nora)

nora (support): notified customers and updated tickets with ETA and final update on recovery. will include incident id 6487654321 in messages.

alex (oncall): handing off to day SRE maria for follow-up and postmortem. i'm going offline. any follow-ups, DM me.

maria (SRE): taking it. will draft postmortem and set scheduled postmortem meeting. tagging owners: @jonathan for LB gating, @sasha for envoy retry policy defaults.

incident-bot: Incident 6487654321 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Next step: postmortem assigned to maria. timeline recorded. incident closed pending RCA.

maria (SRE): quick note for RCA: check rollout automation that allowed weight jump without checking cluster capacity; add an automated canary ramp limit and a preflight capacity check.

jonathan (platform): agree. will add rollout guard to deployment pipeline. also propose default retry policy change to `num_retries: 0` at the edge for gateway routes and let upstream services opt-in.

sasha (eng): will prepare a config upgrade PR with safer defaults and a canary ramp policy. tagging the change with test harness to simulate traffic spike.

nora (support): final customer message prepared; will send once postmortem published. closing support tickets after postmortem.

alex (oncall): thanks team. good work for quick mitigation.

incident-bot: :page_with_curl: Postmortem TO DO: owner=maria, start=6487654321, deadline=6487710000. Add links to logs/metrics/diff in the doc.
